body_html:
Overall strong lesson. One important distinction in Kindergarten is "with support" students can meet grade level expectations if they can complete these tasks with the aid of adults.

While the lesson builds skills on all these standards it does not mean you need to include, and this measure progress, toward all three.

Nice job and good first #edu407 attempt
